data.body: [P2] Preserve absent-error semantics for every operation type. This now parses `Payload: {}` as an all-`None` `ErrorObject`, but `events_to_operations()` normalizes that object only for callbacks. Step, context, and chained-invoke histories therefore expose a non-`None` error through the cloud runner, while direct service-state parsing treats the same empty error as absent. Normalize empty payloads in all operation conversions (or track raw payload presence separately), and add non-callback round-trip tests.
